scope: Static ELF header/program/note prefixes from seven exact retained lxml wheel members; no candidate loading, full-member extraction or dynamic/version-table acceptance.

method.containerValidation: Existing inspect_package before/after and the same held-descriptor _package validation around each selected prefix; source/inventory identities match the retained record.
method.payloadRead: One forward read of4096bytes per exact member; cumulative allowance reserved before each read. No ZipExtFile.seek, skipped output, full-member decompression or secondary binary tool was used to reach later ranges.
method.observation: The bounded parent script parses only the returned ELF64 little-endian header/program structures and in-prefix GNU note fields. It is a one-off artifact observation, not a tested reusable ELF parser or runtime acceptance.

commonObservedFields.interpretation: ELFCLASS64/ELFDATA2LSB, ET_DYN, EM_X86_64. OSABI0 is unspecified/no extensions, not a Linux/glibc/CPython compatibility verdict. The GNU/type3 descriptor is recorded as bytes, not an authenticity or ABI certificate.

acquisition.qualification: Payload counts refer to returned decompressed ELF prefixes. Full source hashing reads the5099355byte archive twice within the existing per-call8MiB archive bound; directory/local-header validation is separate. This is not a claim that total archive acquisition was28672bytes or that internal stdlib allocations were measured.

rangeAssessment.whyStopped: All selected members are deflated. Even reaching the smallest complete dynamic segment by a forward decompressed read would exceed this job's65536byte total, before string/version tables. No skipped output is treated as free, allowance is not reset and no full-member read uses the helper's larger default. This qualifies this job's sequential approach, not every possible future static-inspection design.

primaryReferences.finding: ELF/program fields and PT_DYNAMIC locate stored dynamic metadata; DT_NEEDED names index DT_STRTAB. Static dependency declarations would still differ from actual loader resolution, and archive libraries may also be statically incorporated.
primaryReferences.qualification: Four separate public specification fetches followed the local artifact observation. These are tool-managed reads with no pre-fetch byte-bound or immutable revision claim; they sent no private data and did not replenish the spent PyPI allowance.

qualification: Source/inventory equality and prefix hashes bind selected observations, not an authenticated distribution signature, atomic lock or hostile-writer guarantee. Native linked versions, glibc/CPython ABI, bundled/backported library identity, rights/security/XML and author/render/reopen/human gates remain unresolved. The prior resource/notice records and failures are unchanged.
